class Once:
    def __init__(self, n): self.n = n
    def __iter__(self): return self
    def __next__(self):
        if self.n <= 0:
            raise StopIteration
        self.n -= 1
        return self.n

first = list(o)
second = list(o)
print(first, second, list(Once(2)), o.n)
